title: This product is SUPER!
text: This product is SUPER!. I admit that I was skeptical before purchasing a Poo-Pourri product this time last year, but I now think I'm Poo-Pourri's biggest fan!  Merry Spritzmaz is my favorite scent, but all the ones I have tried before do the job.  My office at work is right across from the women's restroom, and the scent of the air sprays was overwhelming and didn't even cover up the poo smell.  I took Poo-Pourri to work, and my co-workers and I both love it!  Now there is no poo to smell from my office--just the nice scent of Poo-Pourri.  I carry the small size in my purse, and it has saved me multiple times from the unpleasant odor of public restrooms.  My only advice is to stay away from the 8 oz. bottles because the sprayer tends to leak on them.

product_metadata.title: Poo-Pourri Merry Spritzmas Vanilla Peppermint Scent 4 oz Before-You-Go Bathroom Spray
